payload.rationale: This document is a sprint retro touching three load-bearing areas: (1) the Zephyr integration as key unlock — expanded Position_ZephyrIntegrationUnlock, Position_WebhookArchitecture, and Obs_ZephyrRateLimitResolved context; (2) the async decision widget as proof of the anti-Slack positioning thesis — expanded Narrative_AntiSlackPositioning, Narrative_DecisionsEvaporate, Narrative_DecisionCaptureAtConsensus, Position_CoreFeatureDecisionCapture, Position_AntiPatternRealtimeChat, Position_ProductCategoryAsyncPlatform, Position_Sprint4ThesisProven, and Position_TargetMarketRemoteTeams; (3) velocity and pricing metrics — expanded Position_PricingTwelveDollars, Position_PricingTier25Plus, and Position_ContextPreservationNextSprint (next sprint focus). I did not expand the Documents door further since both source documents were already surfaced through their positions, and no People or Dimensions axes exist in this graph.
